list.name: user
list.label: Person
list.query: select u.username as __text, u.id as __value from users u where u.username not like 'claude-test%' and (exists (select 1 from model_calls mc where mc.user_id=u.id and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=mc.diagram_id and dg.scratch)) or exists (select 1 from discussions d join statements s on s.discussion_id=d.id where d.user_id=u.id and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=d.diagram_id and dg.scratch))) order by u.username
list.definition: select u.username as __text, u.id as __value from users u where u.username not like 'claude-test%' and (exists (select 1 from model_calls mc where mc.user_id=u.id and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=mc.diagram_id and dg.scratch)) or exists (select 1 from discussions d join statements s on s.discussion_id=d.id where d.user_id=u.id and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=d.diagram_id and dg.scratch))) order by u.username

panels.description: A turn is cold when its first coach call starts more than 5 minutes after the start of the family's previous turn, so the cached prompt has expired and is written again. Real families only: scratch records and the claude-test account are left out. Coach calls only. The dashed line is the mean over all turns of the 14 days up to that day.

targets.rawSql: with c as (select mc.*, mc.created_at - mc.duration_ms * interval '1 millisecond' as started from model_calls mc join users u on u.id=mc.user_id where mc.purpose = 'coach' and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=mc.diagram_id and dg.scratch) and u.id in ($user) and u.username not like 'claude-test%' and mc.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '14 days' and mc.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamp), t as (select turn_id, diagram_id, min(started) as started, sum(cost_usd) as usd, count(*) as calls, (array_agg(cache_creation_tokens order by created_at, id))[1] as first_write from c group by turn_id, diagram_id), g as (select *, coalesce(started - lag(started) over (partition by diagram_id order by started) > interval '5 minutes', true) as cold from t), d as (select date_trunc('day', started) as day, count(*) as n, sum(usd) as usd, sum(calls) as calls, count(*) filter (where cold) as cn, sum(usd) filter (where cold) as cu, avg(first_write) filter (where cold) as cw, count(*) filter (where not cold) as wn, sum(usd) filter (where not cold) as wu from g group by 1) , m as (select day, cu / nullif(cn, 0) as cold, wu / nullif(wn, 0) as warm, sum(usd) over w / sum(n) over w as mean from d window w as (order by day range between interval '13 days' preceding and current row)) select day as time, cold as "Cold turn", warm as "Warm turn", mean as "All turns, 14-day mean" from m where $__timeFilter(day) order by 1

panels.title: Cost per coach turn a day, warm and cold, with the 14-day mean

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(mc.created_at,'1d'), sum(mc.cache_creation_tokens*r.w)/1e6 as "Cache write", sum(mc.cache_read_tokens*r.c)/1e6 as "Cache read", sum(mc.output_tokens*r.o)/1e6 as "Output", sum(mc.input_tokens*r.i)/1e6 as "Uncached input" from model_calls mc join users u on u.id=mc.user_id join lateral (select i,o,w,c from (values ('claude-opus-4-6',5.00,25.00,6.25,0.50),('claude-opus-4-8',5.00,25.00,6.25,0.50),('claude-opus-5',5.00,25.00,6.25,0.50),('claude-opus-5-5',4.00,20.00,5.00,0.20),('claude-sonnet-5',2.00,10.00,2.50,0.20),('claude-haiku-4-5',1.00,5.00,1.25,0.10),('gemini-3.8-flash',0.75,3.75,0,0.075),('gemini-3.7-flash',0.75,3.75,0,0.075),('gemini-3.6-flash',0.75,3.75,0,0.075),('gemini-3.5-flash',1.50,9.00,0,0.15),('gemini-2.5-flash',0.30,2.50,0,0.03),('gemini-2.5-flash-lite',0.10,0.40,0,0.01)) v(p,i,o,w,c) where mc.model like v.p||'%' order by length(v.p) desc limit 1) r on true where not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=mc.diagram_id and dg.scratch) and mc.purpose = 'coach' and u.id in ($user) and u.username not like 'claude-test%' and $__timeFilter(mc.created_at) group by 1 order by 1

A turn is cold when its first coach call starts more than 5 minutes after the start of the family's previous turn, so the cached prompt has expired and is written again. Real families only: scratch records and the claude-test account are left out. Coach calls only.

targets.rawSql: with c as (select mc.*, mc.created_at - mc.duration_ms * interval '1 millisecond' as started from model_calls mc join users u on u.id=mc.user_id where mc.purpose = 'coach' and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id=mc.diagram_id and dg.scratch) and u.id in ($user) and u.username not like 'claude-test%' and mc.created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp - interval '14 days' and mc.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamp), t as (select turn_id, diagram_id, min(started) as started, sum(cost_usd) as usd, count(*) as calls, (array_agg(cache_creation_tokens order by created_at, id))[1] as first_write from c group by turn_id, diagram_id), g as (select *, coalesce(started - lag(started) over (partition by diagram_id order by started) > interval '5 minutes', true) as cold from t), d as (select date_trunc('day', started) as day, count(*) as n, sum(usd) as usd, sum(calls) as calls, count(*) filter (where cold) as cn, sum(usd) filter (where cold) as cu, avg(first_write) filter (where cold) as cw, count(*) filter (where not cold) as wn, sum(usd) filter (where not cold) as wu from g group by 1) select day as time, calls::float / n as "Calls per turn" from d where $__timeFilter(day) order by 1

panels.description: Basic-data items known over items required, from the last coach turn of each day on each family's record. One line per record, named by its owner and record number. Real families only: scratch records, made-up discussions and the claude-test account are left out.

targets.rawSql: select distinct on (dg.id, date_trunc('day', te.created_at)) date_trunc('day', te.created_at) as time, u.username || ' / ' || dg.id as metric, (te.payload->'coverage'->'after'->>'known')::float / nullif((te.payload->'coverage'->'after'->>'required')::float, 0) as value from turn_events te join discussions d on d.id = te.discussion_id join diagrams dg on dg.id = d.diagram_id join users u on u.id = dg.user_id where te.kind = 'done' and te.payload->'coverage' is not null and not dg.scratch and not d.synthetic and u.id in ($user) and u.username not like 'claude-test%' and $__timeFilter(te.created_at) order by dg.id, date_trunc('day', te.created_at), te.created_at desc, te.id desc
